name: The Source Tee
short_description: A heavyweight relaxed tee defined by a controlled shoulder and clean neckline.
long_description: The Source Tee establishes the capsule's base proportion: relaxed through the body, deliberate at the shoulder and compact at the neck. A restrained back-neck passage stitch becomes the only identity detail.
care_instructions: Prototype guidance: wash at 30°C with similar colours; reshape while damp; do not tumble dry. Final care label requires material and test approval.

name: The Passage Shirt
short_description: An elongated shirt with a straight front, low side splits and soft structure.
long_description: The Passage Shirt uses length, movement and negative space rather than applied decoration. Wear it closed, open as a light layer or partially tucked with The Measure Trouser.
care_instructions: Prototype guidance: wash at 30°C; warm iron; line dry. Final care label requires material and test approval.

name: The Measure Trouser
short_description: A relaxed straight trouser with one controlled front fold and adjustable waist tabs.
long_description: The Measure Trouser balances volume with a clear vertical line. Adjustable waist tabs support flexible unisex fit while the leg remains straight and easy to combine across the capsule.
care_instructions: Prototype guidance: wash at 30°C; wash inside out; line dry. Final care label requires material and test approval.

name: The Structure Overshirt
short_description: A structured overshirt with a straight hem, concealed fastening and offset seam.
long_description: The Structure Overshirt is the capsule's architectural piece. A clean outer surface keeps attention on proportion while one offset seam introduces DEDUNET's passage-line logic.

name: The Trace Scarf
short_description: A light rectangular scarf carrying the sparse Passage Lines motif.
long_description: The Trace Scarf translates the graphic system into textile form. Parallel lines are interrupted by small Resin points, creating a pattern that changes when folded or wrapped.
